summary:
Mastodon’s project site is joinmastodon.org. Individual servers have their own icons, so this page is only the mark on the project homepage, not a user’s instance.

Checked 12 November 2026 against joinmastodon.org. HTML came from https://joinmastodon.org/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 32x32 → https://joinmastodon.org/_next/static/media/favicon-32x32.2_1axy1s32xu0.png; icon 16x16 → https://joinmastodon.org/_next/static/media/favicon-16x16.0ocx8jkwmhmdm.png.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. joinmastodon.org did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #5544dd comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-32x32-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-32x32-01.png at 32×32 (png, 1938 bytes) from https://joinmastodon.org/_next/static/media/favicon-32x32.2_1axy1s32xu0.png.
